BL-1367 — The paused-pager Approve route cannot record a ruling: recordApprovalReply takes no ruling argument, so a ticket approved from the phone reads fully approved while the choice it posed is silently discarded
What it solves: Minted 2026-09-03 by the specifier from a QA priority-00 note on BL-1309.
QA's substantive finding was right and its attribution was wrong; the root
cause below was found by following the second half rather than the first.
Approval context: No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options - which matters here, because this is the ticket about rulings being dropped and it must not model the failure it fixes. . What to know before approving. Invariant 1 says an approval that cannot carry its ruling should not be recorded at all. That …
BL-1367 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1367" (or "reject BL-1367 <reason>") to act.
